questions.history: Subscribe to the saved Observable group only after the one-item outer sequence ends.
questions.prediction: The PR describes first-item loss from premature abandonment. On the merge the single K group must deliver 7 exactly once and complete.
questions.basis: Only one source item exists. Delaying the subscription to this abandoned group cannot give it a second source item. The value already assigned to it is the one observable distinction.
questions.refutation: The merge yields an empty completed group, a duplicated 7, or a different key.

questions.history: For Observable.just(7,8) with the same constant key and no failing selector, subscribe to the group synchronously inside outer onNext.
questions.prediction: Both revisions should yield one group with [7,8] and normal completion.
questions.basis: The synchronous inner observer claims the group before abandonment. Each source item maps unchanged to the same key.
questions.refutation: A missing or duplicate item, extra group, or error on either revision.

questions.history: For a single item 7, retain key K but make the value selector throw a particular exception instance. Subscribe immediately to each emitted group. Run the same fixture as a Flowable with unbounded demand and as an Observable.
questions.prediction: On the merge both outer observers should emit one K group and terminate with the thrown error. Each inner observer should receive that same exception with zero values. The parent Flowable can suppress the group on this path.
questions.basis: The key is known before the value conversion. Independent inner and outer subscribers check where the selector’s failure becomes observable.
questions.refutation: The outer error is correct but no group arrives, any inner succeeds, or either subscriber gets a replacement exception.
